title: Blokky plan
description: Blokky plan documents (spec 1.0.0-draft). Normative for structure; spec/reference.md is normative for semantics and lists the rules this schema can't express. Every plan scalar is a string to Blokky; so that YAML editors (which type unquoted scalars) validate too, scalar fields also accept JSON booleans and numbers of the right form.

scalar.description: Any scalar; Blokky reads it as a string.

bool.description: Exactly true or false; True, yes, on and 1 are errors (SY-53).

int.description: A non-negative decimal integer without leading zeros (SY-54).

posInt.description: A positive decimal integer without leading zeros (SY-54).

exitCode.description: An exit code, 0 to 4294967295 (Windows exit codes are unsigned 32-bit values).

decimal.description: A non-negative decimal number such as 2 or 1.5.

duration.description: A duration: <integer><unit> parts with units h, m, s, ms in descending order (500ms, 10s, 1h30m). No bare numbers and no fractions: 1500ms, not 1.5s (SY-56, SY-57).

specVersion.description: The spec version the plan targets, MAJOR.MINOR such as 1.0 (SY-51).

varName.description: A plan variable name: an uppercase letter, then uppercase letters, digits and _; not starting with BLOKKY_ (SY-52).

envName.description: An environment variable name: a letter or _, then letters, digits and _.

userCode.description: A user error code: an uppercase letter, then uppercase letters, digits and _; not starting with BK_.

lockName.description: A lock name: a lowercase letter or digit, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. An unquoted number is read as written (lock: 2024).

tempdirPrefix.description: A tempdir name prefix: 1 to 32 letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'. An unquoted number is read as written.

regex.description: A regular expression in the portable subset (syntax.md section 6.7; RF-22), best single-quoted. Any scalar is read as written.

jsonPath.description: A JSON path in the jq-like subset, starting with . (.number, .head.ref, .[0].name; SY-63).

setMap.description: set and vars values: a literal or template (strings with ${X} placeholders), or a whole-value reference.

condition.description: One subject plus one operator (with optional json and ignore_case), a bare probe, or a composite. The one-subject/one-operator rule is enforced by implementations (spec/conditions.md).

forSettings.description: On a node with for, concurrency and fail_fast belong inside for: (reference.md section 7, RF-31).

nodeRules.description: Validity rules the schema expresses (reference.md sections 5.2 and 7; RF-3 to RF-5, RF-12, RF-28, RF-30 to RF-33).

node.description: A node. Every key a node may carry is listed here, so an error is reported at its own key; the validity rules are in nodeRules.

exec.description: Kind: run a program, as a string or an argv list; no shell.

script.description: Kind: run shell text, best as a | block scalar; the shell comes from shell: or detection.

do.description: Kind: run the listed nodes in order.

all.description: Kind: run the listed nodes concurrently; fails if any fails.

any.description: Kind: run the listed nodes concurrently; succeeds if any succeeds.

race.description: Kind: run the listed nodes concurrently; the first to complete decides.

if.description: Kind: evaluate a condition, then run then: or else:.

log.description: Kind: record a message (${X} interpolated, secrets masked).

fail.description: Kind: fail the node with a message.

assert.description: Kind: fail the node unless a condition holds.

set.description: Kind: bind variables from literals, templates or references.

return.description: Kind: end the nearest enclosing sequence successfully, with a message.

shell.description: The shell for script: bash, sh, pwsh, powershell or zsh.

then.description: With if: the nodes to run when the condition is true.

else.description: With if: the nodes to run when the condition is false.

level.description: With log: debug, info (default) or warn.

message.description: With assert: the message when the condition is false.

code.description: With fail or assert: the user error code (default BK_FAIL, BK_ASSERT).

concurrency.description: With all or any: how many children run at once.

fail_fast.description: With do or all: stop the remaining children as soon as one fails.

stdin.description: Leaf option: the standard input, literal text, { var: X } or { file: P }; empty by default.

ok_exit.description: Leaf option: extra exit codes that count as success.

stderr.description: Leaf option: merge sends stderr into the stdout stream.

encoding.description: Leaf option: how output is decoded (default utf-8).

keep_descendants.description: Leaf option: keep the leaf's remaining processes at completion (true) or past the run (detach).

capture.description: Leaf option: bind stdout, or JSON fields of it, to variables.

capture_file.description: Leaf option: write stdout to a run-owned file and bind its path.

secret.description: Leaf option: mark every capture of this node as secret.

name.description: A display name for the node (${X} interpolated).

when.description: Modifier: a guard; when false, the node is skipped.

timeout.description: Modifier: the node's total wall-clock limit.

lock.description: Modifier: hold a named advisory lock for the node, NAME or { name, wait }.

tempdir.description: Modifier: run the node in a fresh temporary directory.

cwd.description: Modifier: the node's working directory, relative to the parent's.

env.description: Modifier: environment variables for every process in the node's scope.

export.description: Modifier: export plan variables as environment variables of the same name.

container.description: Modifier: run the node's leaves in a container.

services.description: Modifier: background processes started, and waited for, before the body, and stopped after it.

finally.description: Modifier: nodes that run after the body, whatever its outcome.

finally_timeout.description: Modifier: the time limit for finally.

ignore_errors.description: Modifier: a failure of this node doesn't fail its parent.

retry.description: Repetition: run again after a failure, true or a condition on the error; with max.

while.description: Repetition: run while a condition holds; with max or timeout.

until.description: Repetition: run until a condition holds; with max or timeout.

for.description: Repetition: run once per item of a list, count, glob, JSON array, lines or matrix.

attempt_timeout.description: Repetition: the time limit for each attempt or iteration.

max.description: Repetition: the most attempts or iterations, the first included.

every.description: Repetition: the delay between attempts or iterations (default 1s).

backoff.description: With retry: grow the delay by factor after each attempt, up to max.

jitter.description: With retry: randomize each delay by up to this fraction.

on_body_failure.description: With while or until: stop (default) or continue when an iteration fails.

index.description: Repetition: bind the attempt or iteration number to a variable.

carry.description: With while or until: pass a value from one iteration to the next.

collect.description: Repetition: gather a variable from every iteration into a list.

default.description: The value used when none is supplied; an input without one is required.

description.description: What the input is for, shown to whoever supplies it.

matches.description: A pattern the value must match (unanchored search).

root.description: The root mapping: the plan-only keys plus the root node's keys.

blokky.description: The spec version the plan targets, such as 1.0 (SY-35).

inputs.description: The plan's inputs: values supplied when the plan runs, by NAME (syntax.md section 5).

vars.description: Plan-wide variables bound before anything runs, from literals, templates, inputs and from_env.

outputs.description: Variables whose final values the run result returns.

defaults.description: Plan-wide defaults: the script shell and a time limit for every leaf.
